capabilities.feature: PDF file structures and reported recovery
capabilities.implemented: Classic/xref streams, object streams, hybrid revisions, page trees and reported reconstruction.
capabilities.remaining: Current-corpus recovery classification; external resources require a host contract.

capabilities.implemented: Complete-buffer opening, lazy object caches and immutable source bytes are available.
capabilities.remaining: Immutable range sources, missing-data state, scoped loading, linearization and resumable host jobs (ADR 0035 proposed).

capabilities.implemented: Standard security R2-R6, RC4/AES and R6 SASLprep; CLI supports legacy text conversion.
capabilities.remaining: Public-key handlers, encrypted history and browser legacy text conversion; writing encryption is E01.

capabilities.implemented: TrueType/OpenType glyf, Type 1, CFF Expert/ExpertSubset and FDSelect 4; default CFF2 blends.
capabilities.remaining: Remaining formats, variations, executable programs and policy-controlled hinting; see the font inventory.

capabilities.implemented: Provider-backed horizontal substitution for the supported Adobe collections; embedded vertical text works.
capabilities.remaining: Vertical substituted glyph forms/metrics and unavailable provider/collection coverage.

capabilities.implemented: JPEG sequential/progressive with Huffman/arithmetic, CCITT G3/G4, JBIG2 regions and JPEG 2000 Part 1.
capabilities.remaining: Inventory valid residual JPEG, CCITT, JBIG2 and JPX variants rather than interpreting generic filter tags as total absence.

capabilities.implemented: SMaskInData 1/2 decode and compositing, including alpha normalization/unpremultiplication.
capabilities.remaining: Indexed opacity/channel mapping and additional colour/layout interactions are separate remaining R02 work.

capabilities.implemented: Explicit PDF colour spaces and embedded Gray/RGB/CMYK mapping.
capabilities.remaining: Embedded ICC/sYCC and remaining precedence/channel-layout integration.

capabilities.implemented: Gray/RGB/CMYK groups, knockout, blend modes, masks, forward ICC and process/spot overprint display.
capabilities.remaining: Destination/inverse ICC, calibrated group destinations, black-point compensation and transfer-region combinations.

capabilities.implemented: One interpreter, prepared scenes, per-buffer formats and one exact band executor; paths, clips, shadings and patterns.
capabilities.remaining: Valid singular-transform/pattern refusals and independent accuracy evidence for difficult geometry.

capabilities.implemented: Stored appearances, Link/Square borders, Text icons and supported empty widgets.
capabilities.remaining: Other subtype appearances, richer borders, nonempty/rotated widgets and interaction states.

capabilities.implemented: Text/choice/button filling, appearance generation, saved values and appearances, browser preview/discard/download.
capabilities.remaining: Rich text, broader encodings/transforms, generated button states and nested direct fields; XFA belongs to V03.

capabilities.implemented: Actions are inert views; XFA is detected; ordinary AcroForms have separate support.
capabilities.remaining: Explicit host capability/ADR decisions, XFA layout/data/events and baseline-supported script/action subsets.

capabilities.implemented: Geometric text/search, replacement text, a separate tagged logical view and a screen-reader-readable DOM layer.
capabilities.remaining: Logical-view integration into viewer accessibility, namespaces, remaining replacements and bidi/script reconstruction.

capabilities.implemented: Optional-content evaluation with View usage; library/CLI overprint choices.
capabilities.remaining: Layer UI/configuration and Print/Export usage, print preferences and host/viewer overprint control.

capabilities.implemented: RenderContext lends final RGBA bands after preflight; fallible consumers and stops between bands; CLI streams PPM.
capabilities.remaining: Persistent pause/resume, host active-request cancellation and async backpressure; calls currently restart.

capabilities.implemented: Whole-buffer PNG and DEFLATE encoders in the codec crate.
capabilities.remaining: Facade/CLI PNG output and incremental PNG/DEFLATE; extend existing algorithms and band output.

capabilities.implemented: ImageSource describes encoded images and defers sample decoding for rendering.
capabilities.remaining: Asset/resource/occurrence inventory, exact-stream eligibility and normalized isolated-image export APIs.

capabilities.implemented: Low-level immutable object access and typed navigation exist.
capabilities.remaining: Typed metadata/XMP, embedded/associated files, portfolios, thumbnails and their public workflows.

capabilities.feature: Writing, full rewrite and encryption output
capabilities.implemented: Deterministic new PDF 1.7 output and classic/xref-stream incremental revisions.
capabilities.remaining: Full rewrite, object deletion/streams, PDF 2.0 output and encryption-on-write; modified saves currently require strict unencrypted input.

capabilities.implemented: Immutable transactions, rollback, no-op byte preservation and form editing.
capabilities.remaining: Typed page/content/annotation authoring, merge/split, resource remapping, undo/redo and associated service edits.

capabilities.implemented: Incremental edits preserve prior revisions; they provide no sanitization guarantee.
capabilities.remaining: Content-aware removal plus full rewrite and independent hidden-content/canary scans.

capabilities.feature: Historical signatures and structural change analysis
capabilities.implemented: Historical discovery, ByteRange/revision coverage and structural DocMDP/FieldMDP classification.
capabilities.remaining: Encrypted/repaired history and remaining transforms/exceptions; integrate results with save permission enforcement.

capabilities.feature: CMS integrity and PDF trust integration
capabilities.implemented: CMS/CAdES/RFC3161 integrity; separate host-anchored PKI path and offline complete/indirect/delta CRL APIs.
capabilities.remaining: PDF results still leave trust/time/revocation unchecked; connect real crypto and add OCSP, TSA and PAdES/LTV policy.

capabilities.implemented: Verification-only primitives and original-byte-preserving incremental infrastructure.
capabilities.remaining: ADR for host signing provider, reservations, CMS/CAdES creation, timestamps and independent validation.

capabilities.implemented: Version headers and PDF/X print-intent declarations are recognized; this is not profile validation.
capabilities.remaining: Explicit PDF/A, PDF/UA, PDF/X and baseline-supported extension validators and conforming creation gates.
